app_fee.value: Clarkson is waiving graduate application fees for now, so there is no fee to pay.
app_fee.quote: To support prospective graduate students, we are waiving application fees at this time.

fee_waiver.value: Because the application fee is waived, there is no fee to waive.
fee_waiver.quote: To support prospective graduate students, we are waiving application fees at this time.

gre_general.value: The graduate school leaves GRE rules to each program; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: GMAT/GRE test scores. For information and instructions related to waivers, please visit the page for your intended program of study.

toefl_min.value: The international admissions page lists the minimum TOEFL as 4.5 on the new scale; the older how-to-apply page still shows 80.
toefl_min.quote: Accepted tests with minimum acceptable scores are: TOEFL (4.5), TOEFL Essentials (8.5), IELTS (6.5), PTE (56), Duolingo English Test (115).

also.quote: Accepted tests with minimum acceptable scores are: TOEFL (80) and TOEFL Essentials (8.5), IELTS (6.5), PTE (56) or Duolingo English Test (115).

ielts_min.value: The overall IELTS minimum is 6.5; the IELTS General Edition is not accepted.
ielts_min.quote: Accepted tests with minimum acceptable scores are: TOEFL (80) and TOEFL Essentials (8.5), IELTS (6.5), PTE (56) or Duolingo English Test (115).

also.quote: The IELTS General Edition is not accepted.

english_waiver.value: An English-medium degree from India does not waive the English test, because Clarkson does not waive it for language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: We do not automatically waive this requirement based on language of instruction, nor do we accept university certificates.

notes: Graduate pages say TOEFL (80); the international page's graduate list says TOEFL (4.5), the same list as its undergraduate section, so 80 is used. Department pages repeat TOEFL (80) and IELTS (6.5). Waiver for native-English countries: India is not on the list in the PDF linked from the physics page (https://www.clarkson.edu/sites/default/files/2023-09/CountriesWhereEnglishistheNativeLanguage.pdf). Rolling admissions with no set deadline.
